caption: The drawing depicts two separated botanical elements on a plain, light background. On the left, there is a cluster of plant stems with broad, green leaves and several small, red buds, as well as a few five-petaled flowers that are yellow with red centers. The right side features a single brown stem with multiple slender green leaves attached, some in light green and others in a darker green shade, without any flowers or buds present. Both botanical elements are set against irregular, textured beige or tan shapes that contrast with the white background. The objects are drawn with visible attention to detail in the leaves and color transitions, arranged side by side but not touching or overlapping.
title: Silk Petticoat (Fragment)
